meta.name: RuPauls Secret Celebrity Drag Race
meta.description: Secret celebrities - from all walks of life - compete in full drag as they try to impress Emmy Award winning host, RuPaul. To save themselves from elimination, they have to lip sync for their lives. In the end, one celebrity will be crowned America's Next Celebrity Drag Superstar.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Queen Supremes Trixie Mattel, Bob The Drag Queen and Monet X Change make over Nico Tortorella, Jordan Connor and Jermaine Fowler before the celebs compete in Snatch Game.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Queen Supremes Alyssa Edwards, Asia O'Hara and Trinity The Tuck drag up Loni Love, Tami Roman and Vanessa Williams for their performances in a "9 to 5"-inspired musical.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Queen Supremes Bob The Drag Queen, Kim Chi and Nina West give drag makeovers to celebrity guests Alex Newell, Dustin Milligan and Matt Iseman for The Roast of RuPaul.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In this conclusion to the four part special event, three new celebrities step inside the workroom to form a fierce glam rock-inspired pop group sensation. Queens Supremes Alyssa Edwards, Monique Heart and Vanessa Vangie Mateo drag up Hayley Kiyoko, Madison Beer and Phoebe Robinson.
